create_refEvaluation: create a RefEvaluation instance to compute BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L, and CIDEr scores for refer expressions
run_refEvaluation_evaluate: run the evaluate method on a RefEvaluation instance to compute and print reference expression metrics
build_refer_scores: build evaluation scores dict with BLEU_1 through BLEU_4, METEOR, ROUGE-L, and CIDEr for refer expressions
review_refToEval: review the refToEval dict mapping each ref_id to its per-metric evaluation scores
test_evalRefs: test the evalRefs list containing per-reference evaluation results with ref_id and all metric scores
